_comment: The name of the layout sidecar that sits beside a rendered preview PNG,
The rule: take the PNG's name without its extension and append
Python writes the file (generate_collage and generate_reel_scroll) and
Swift reads it, from the crop editor, the collage thumbnail and the
export compositor. Swift used to rebuild the name in five places, one of
them a hardcoded literal, with nothing forcing them to agree. The first
one changed would break the editor or the export on one screen only,
while the others kept working, which is the hardest version of this to
Changing the naming rule means changing this file once, and whichever
side was not updated fails loudly.
